Mid Body.role: Central monocoque: floor, sidepods, cockpit and airbox. Everything else references this part.

Front Body.role: Nose cone and the complete front wing, moulded as one piece. The square socket in its rear face receives the Mid Body locator.

Halo.role: Cockpit safety hoop. Two rear posts and one front pillar drop into three slots around the cockpit opening.

Back Body.role: Gearbox, diffuser and rear wing. Locates on three pins and glues to the rear face of the Mid Body.

Left Rear Suspension.role: Left rear wishbone set. Three rods on a flat inboard plate that sits in a recess on the Back Body.

Right Rear Suspension.role: Right rear wishbone set, mirror of the left.

Rear Stabiliser Fin.role: Thin fin that slots into the engine cover behind the airbox.

Locating Pin 1.role: Alignment pin, one of three. Dry fit into the rear face of the Mid Body.

Side Camera Mount.role: Camera pod on the sidepod shoulder, left.

Side Camera Mount 2.role: Camera pod on the sidepod shoulder, right.

Front Wheel Inner Hub A 1.file: Separate STLs/Front Wheel Inner Hub A 1.stl
Front Wheel Inner Hub A 1.role: Front inner hub half A, left. Clamps around the front axle stub together with half B.

Front Wheel Inner Hub B 1.file: Separate STLs/Front Wheel Inner Hub B 1.stl
Front Wheel Inner Hub B 1.role: Front inner hub half B, left. Glues to half A only, so the pair spins as one collar.

Front Wheel Inner Hub A 2.file: Separate STLs/Front Wheel Inner Hub A 2.stl
Front Wheel Inner Hub A 2.role: Front inner hub half A, right.

Front Wheel Inner Hub B 2.file: Separate STLs/Front Wheel Inner Hub B 2.stl
Front Wheel Inner Hub B 2.role: Front inner hub half B, right.

Rear Axle.role: 75mm shaft. Glued into one rear hub, then threaded through suspension, body and opposite suspension.

Rear Wheel Hub 1.role: Rear wheel hub, left. The axle glues into its centre bore; the tyre presses onto its outer rim.

Rear Wheel Hub 2.role: Rear wheel hub, right. Glued onto the far end of the axle after it is threaded through the body.

Rear Tyre L.role: Rear tyre, left. Interference press fit, no glue, so it stays replaceable.

Front Wheel Hub 1.role: Front wheel hub, left. Glues onto the outer face of the inner-hub collar, never to the axle stub.

Front Tyre L.role: Front tyre, left. Narrower than the rears.

Front Mini-Wing.role: Small winglet that threads through a slot in the nose so both tips protrude equally.

Top Camera Mount.role: Camera pod on top of the airbox.

steps.title: Parts check
steps.desc: All 18 unique parts, laid out as they come off the print bed. Hover any part to see its name, its number in the parts list and what it does. Remove supports and clean the edges before you start.

fasten.t: Hover a part to identify it

steps.title: Locating pins
steps.desc: Push the three Locating Pins into the three holes in the REAR face of the Mid Body. Dry fit, no glue on the pins themselves: they exist to align the Back Body, not to hold it. Press each one until its shoulder is flush with the face.

steps.title: Back Body
steps.desc: Glue the Back Body onto the rear face of the Mid Body. Spread a thin even coat on the flat mating face only, then drop the Back Body straight down the three pins until the seam closes with no gap. The pins carry the alignment, the glue carries the load.

fasten.t: Glue — thin coat on the flat face

steps.title: Front Body
steps.desc: The square locator on the front of the Mid Body is the key. Put glue INSIDE the square socket of the Front Body, not on the outer seam, then slide the Front Body straight back along the car axis until the two shells butt edge to edge. Check from above that the nose is square before the glue grabs.

steps.title: Left rear suspension
steps.desc: Glue the flat inboard plate of the left suspension and set it into the shallow recess on the side of the Back Body. Bring it in horizontally, not from above: the three rods must enter their recesses together. The top rod should just touch the underside of the rear wing endplate, which sets the rake.

fasten.t: Glue — plate face into the recess

steps.title: Right rear suspension
steps.desc: Repeat on the right side. Compare both sides by eye from the rear before the glue sets: the two hub cups must sit at the same height and the same distance from the body, or the axle will not spin true.

fasten.t: Glue — plate face into the recess

steps.title: Front mini-wing
steps.desc: Slide the Front Mini-Wing through the slot in the nose so an equal amount protrudes on each side. One small drop of glue in the slot is enough. Sight along the nose from the front to check it is level.

fasten.t: Glue — one drop in the slot

steps.title: Rear axle + first hub
steps.desc: Glue the Rear Axle into the centre bore of the LEFT rear hub only, pushing it in until it bottoms out. Then thread the bare end of the axle through the left suspension, the Back Body and the right suspension. Keep glue away from those three bores or the axle will seize.

fasten.t: Glue — inside the hub bore only

steps.title: Second rear hub
steps.desc: Glue the right rear hub onto the protruding axle end, pushing it fully home so both hubs sit the same distance from the body. Spin it immediately, before the glue cures: it must turn freely with no wobble.

fasten.t: Glue — axle end into the bore

steps.title: Rear tyres
steps.desc: Press the two rear tyres straight onto the hubs, not at an angle. It is a tight interference fit and deliberately takes no glue, so a tyre can be replaced later.

steps.title: Left front inner hub
steps.desc: The two halves clamp around the left front axle stub. Try them dry first. Glue the two halves TO EACH OTHER along their flat mating faces only, never to the stub, and make sure the backs finish flush. Once cured the pair spins on the stub as one collar.
joints: Front Wheel Inner Hub A 1|Front Wheel Inner Hub B 1

steps.title: Right front inner hub
steps.desc: Repeat on the right stub. The front wheels are designed with a little camber, so a finished wheel will not stand perfectly vertical. That is correct.
joints: Front Wheel Inner Hub A 2|Front Wheel Inner Hub B 2

steps.title: Front hubs
steps.desc: Glue each front hub onto the outer face of its inner-hub collar, keeping the glue on that face so it cannot run into the stub. Spin each one to confirm it still turns before moving on.
joints: Front Wheel Hub 1|Front Wheel Inner Hub A 1
Front Wheel Hub 2|Front Wheel Inner Hub A 2

steps.title: Front tyres
steps.desc: Press the two front tyres on dry, exactly like the rears. They are narrower than the rear pair, so do not mix them up.

steps.title: Camera mounts
steps.desc: Glue the three camera pods into their locating holes: one on each sidepod shoulder and one on top of the airbox. A single drop in each hole, then press the pod down until its base sits flat on the bodywork. Sight across the car from the front so both side pods stand at the same angle, and check the top pod points straight forward along the centreline.

steps.title: Halo
steps.desc: The Halo has three legs: two rear posts and one front pillar. Lower it straight down so all three enter their slots at the same time, then press until the hoop sits level. Glue in the slots, not on the cockpit rim, so none squeezes out where it will show.

fasten.t: Glue — thin bead in the 3 slots

steps.title: Rear stabiliser fin
steps.desc: Slide the thin fin into the slot on the engine cover, vertical and on the centreline. A bead along the slot is enough; the fin is fragile, so press on its base, not its tip.

steps.title: Finished
steps.desc: The completed car. The rear axle turns as one with both rear wheels; each front wheel spins on its own stub. Let the glue cure fully before rolling it.
